limitation_preservation.limitation_prompt: Separate recorded outcome and diagnostics from unique physical causation or a measured explanation of bad/slow motion. Explicit uncertainty OR clearly source-bounded observation wording is acceptable. Do not claim a measured delay mechanism, obstacle identity, inhibited applied motion or safety-speed policy from these records.
limitation_preservation.response_span: The record does not show why navigation timed out.

limitation_preservation.limitation_prompt: Unavailable manual, charging, localization and planner/controller diagnostic channels cannot be treated as false, normal, successful or absent physical mechanisms. Mentioning each missing channel is optional when the answer remains bounded to retained outcomes.
limitation_preservation.response_span: The navigation skill timed out and failed; the later steps were still waiting. The record does not show why navigation timed out.
